    • meta

      @SafeVarargs public final Hero.Builder meta(Composable<Caption>... metaLines)
      Meta lines of the heading group, in call order — a slug, a counter, a date. Called with nothing to say it is refused: a line that meant something and lost it is worth an exception rather than a page quietly missing it.

    • badge

      public Hero.Builder badge(Composable<?> badge)
      A status line under the hero — "in stock", "draft", "archived". The element is the consumer's, and so is the name its adapter carries: the guard asks for statusBadgeEl, which no fragment of the kit defines. What the kit fixes is the place and the shape of the slot, not what goes in it.

    • actions

      public Hero.Builder actions(Composable<?> actions)
      The row of actions under the hero. Same arrangement as badge(io.thymekit.Composable<?>): the adapter is named actionsEl and lives in consumer code.
